hero.tagline: Where twilight gathers the day's last glow

today.heading: The deepening gold — midsummer's quiet zenith
today.intro: June deepens. The solstice approaches and the days stretch long, each evening lingering like a held breath. In this pause between planting and harvest, the garden is at its fullest — tulips standing tall beside lilies, sunflowers tracking the arc of light. There is a particular clarity to this season: the world reveals itself without apology, and we are invited to meet it with equal honesty.

visualAsset.description: Impressionist meadow at midsummer peak — tulips and lilies swaying in golden light, brushstroke sky

moon.label: I. The Moon
moon.heading: Borrowed brilliance in a silver sky
moon.intro: To shine by reflected light is not a lesser act — it is an act of trust. The Moon receives and returns, asks nothing, keeps nothing. Its glow is not theft but devotion: a daily proof that receiving fully and giving completely can be the same gesture.

philosophy.label: II. The Waves
philosophy.heading: The wave forgets it is the sea
philosophy.intro: The wave rises, certain of its separate crown, proud of its momentary height — then breaks, discovering it was never anything but the sea wearing a different shape. The ego is this fleeting insistence on form: a ripple that mistakes its curve for its substance. To dissolve is not loss but homecoming, a return to the depth that was never left.

gita.label: III. The Battlefield
gita.heading: Freedom beyond the fruit of action
gita.intro: The Gita was not spoken in a garden or a palace but on a field of war — where the stakes were absolute and every choice carried the weight of worlds. This is its radical claim: that the deepest wisdom does not require withdrawal from life but full immersion in it, with hands open and heart unguarded.

shiva.label: IV. The Dance
shiva.heading: The drum that speaks the universe
shiva.intro: Shiva does not dance for applause. The Tandava needs no audience because the audience is the dance — every atom, every star, every breath a movement in the choreography of becoming. Stillness and motion are not opposites here; they are the same gesture, seen from inside and outside the drum's resonance.

art.label: V. The Canvas
art.heading: Light as the only subject
art.intro: A sunflower does not manufacture its gold — it conspires with the dawn, translating photons into living pigment, light into color that breathes. The impressionist understood: beauty is never owned, never static. It exists only in the meeting — between eye and world, between hand and canvas, between one vanishing moment and the next that follows it.
